full_judgment:
10. Leave was granted in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 29 of 1986 to consider whether the findings based upon consideration for the first time of khatians Exhibit-B and B-1 allowing share to defendant No. 11 is sustainable because in the revisional jurisdiction the court could not determine a question of fact for the first time if that question had not been determined before; whether the decision arrived at by the High Court Division was without consideration of material evidence on record with regard to the land purchased from Marium Khatun in two plots one of which is Nal and the other is Bari and those khatians having been prepared 50 years back, lands are now built up and part of a commercial area; and whether the High Court Division did not consider the report of the Pleader. Commissioner where it was stated that the partible lands are the ejmali, undivided homestead, viti, tanks etc. and that the defendant Nos. 2 and 7 along with others live thereon. 

 17. The claim of the appellant in Civil Appeal No. 281 of 2001 is based on the finding of the trial Court that the land which was acquired in the saham of defendant No. 11, who is stranger in the Suit Khatian could be purchased by defendants Nos. 2 and 7 in accordance with Section 4 of the Partition Act. However, on scrutiny of the evidence on record the High Court Division has found that the property in question being nal land not dwelling house, Section 4 of the Partition Act has no manner of application. The High Court Division observed that plot Nos. 8450 and 8454, from which defendant No. 11 claims land, are recorded as nal land in Khatians Ext. 13-13(1) and that there is no finding by the courts below that 1 kani 6 gondas 2 kara and 5½ danta land allowed to defendant No. 11 constitutes a dwelling house. In view of such observation the High Court Division reversed the order of the trial Court allowing defendant Nos. 2 and 7 to purchase the share of land allowed in the saham of defendant No. 11, and thus modified the judgment and order of the trial Court to the extent that defendant No. 11 is entitled to retain the 1 kani 6 gondas 2 kara 5¼ danta land allowed to his saham and defendant Nos. 2 and 7 are not entitled to purchase the same. 

 18. The Judgment and order of the High Court Division with regard to the character of the land being nal land as evidenced by the Khatians is based on proper appreciation of the evidence and materials on record and, accordingly, the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division does not call for any interference.
